name: kokeshi2
desc: pixel art game sprite, side view facing right: a Japanese kokeshi wooden doll riding a sleek 1960s British custom cafe racer motorcycle, lying low and tucked over the long tank (the doll has no arms or legs, round head with black bob hair, cylindrical body painted with red and black chrysanthemums). The bike: low clip-on handlebars, a small round fly screen, a long fuel tank painted like a kokeshi with turned rings and chrysanthemums, a humped single seat cowl with a round number plate, swept-up chrome megaphone exhaust, rear-set footpegs, thin aluminum spoked wheels. Sporty and cool

refs.use: keep this kokeshi rider and colors; make the bike a sharper cafe racer
